Sam — thanks again for taking time to meet with us. Per our discovery last week, we'd like to do a 30-min deep dive demo focused on cost/latency tradeoffs and routing policies.

Current proposed: Thursday 4/14, 10:30–11:00am PT (calendar invite attached). Dev will lead the technical walk-through; Marissa will cover pricing and rollout options.

Options I see:
- Shift the demo to 9:00–9:30am PT on 4/14 (still this week) — I can make that.
- Move to Friday 4/15, 11:00–11:30am PT.

Marissa — can you confirm if you prefer to keep the original time and have Neha step in for dev? If we change the slot, I'll update the running notes and the demo checklist.

- Thursday 4/14 9:00–9:30am PT, or
